prerequisites: Basic knowledge about structure of a computer and its components, as well as on operating systems and principles of algorithm structure.
Knowledge of mathematics, covering basic problems of algebra and analysis.
Ability to use basic IT tools of CAE class.

learning_outcomes.text: Ability to formulate a proceeding algorithm for mathematic calculations in the fields of algebra and analysis, covering, among others, matrix, differential and integral calculi, as well as problems related to solving systems of algebraic equations.
Ability to utilize possibilities of 2D and 3D graphics to visualize data and calculation results.
Ability to build a simple model of an object and to start simulation in the Matlab/Simulink system.
Ability to search-out and use professional literature recommended for the course and to acquire knowledge independently.
Ability to make use of modern IT tools.
Understanding of the necessity of systematic and individual work on mastering the course content.

syllabus_topics: General characteristics of Matlab system (graphic interface, environment maintaining, organization of work, system syntax) – exemplary applications.
Operations on files and folders, saving and executing basic mathematical operations (evaluating function values).
Vector and matrix calculi (basic matrix and table operations, identifying elements, generating vectors and matrices).
Two-dimensional graphics in Matlab system – graphics generating functions, description of charts, window management.
Three-dimensional graphics in Matlab system – graphics generating functions, description of charts, window management, animation 3D.
Basics of programming in Matlab system (operators; conditional, iteration and switch statements).
Basics of programming in Matlab system (compound statements; scripts and functions, creating M-files).
Numerical methods: interpolation and approximation of functions.
Solving equations and systems of equations – methods of solving.
Numerical integration – characteristics of integration methods.
Simulink – introduction to modelling technical objects (terminology, principles of building models and starting-up simulations).
Building a simulation model based on the Simulink module library – analysis of influence of initial conditions and simulation parameters on calculation results.
Building a model for a selected technical object – analysis of influence of initial conditions and simulation parameters on calculation results.
teaching_methods: Auxiliary materials in form of instructions and multimedia presentations helpful at executing individual subjects.
Tasks for checking knowledge within individual subjects.
Self study - preparation for project class.

assessment_methods.method: Assessment of preparation for executing subsequent project subjects, checking gained knowledge on the ground of test tasks.

assessment_rules: The concluding grade P is equal to the formative assessment F1, which involves assessment of preparation for executing subsequent project subjects and checking gained knowledge on the ground of test tasks. The course is credited with a grade.
